messages.content:
The handbook pages are getting long, and the tables of contents that people write by
hand go stale or point to anchors that do not exist. Please add a toc command to mdkit:

- mdkit toc FILE should print the table of contents of a page: a nested Markdown list
  with one entry per heading of level 2 and deeper, in page order, written as
  `- [Title](#anchor)` and indented by two spaces per level below 2. The title is the
  heading text as mdkit outline shows it, and the page title (level 1) is not listed.
  Print only the list. --depth N should limit it to headings of level 2 to N.
- The anchors have to be the ones the handbook site generates, or the links will not
  work there. docs/ANCHORS.md describes how the site builds them; the docs platform
  team maintains that page.
- mdkit toc --write FILE should keep the list in the page itself: replace the lines
  between a `<!-- toc -->` line and a `<!-- /toc -->` line with the current list and
  leave the rest of the file exactly as it is, so that running it again on an
  up-to-date page changes nothing. A page that does not have both lines should be left
  alone, with an error and exit status 2.

Errors such as a missing file should work the way they do for the other commands, and
mdkit outline, mdkit links, and mdkit stats should keep working exactly as they do now.
